title: Grateful Dead Live at World Music Festival on 1982-11-26

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a sunrise beach gig captures a high‑energy set highlighted by a smoking Fire on the Mountain and tight drumming, with overall solid sound.
ai_review.review: The show opens at dawn on the beach and maintains an upbeat vibe through a lively first set, while the second set delivers a standout Fire on the Mountain featuring crisp vocals, aggressive synths and Jerry’s shredding. Recording quality is clean and well‑balanced for a soundboard source, though some vocal moments are noted as weary. Overall the performance is tight, energetic and enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review gives 4 stars; it praises both musical performance (high energy, standout songs) and a clean soundboard recording, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and balanced mix with crisp vocals; no major dropouts or muddiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set keeps an upbeat, slightly reggae‑tinged groove; second set builds momentum with a powerful Fire on the Mountain, a concise drums/space segment, and finishes strong with Not Fade Away into Black Peter.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals sound a bit weary early (Althea) but he shreds later in Fire on the Mountain; overall solid guitar work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Very present and energetic on 'Women are Smarter', adding strong bass lines throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby's growl missing on Throwing Stones, but his vocal harmonies with Brent shine on Not Fade Away and Black Peter.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent delivers crisp vocals and an aggressive synthesizer‑driven climax on Fire on the Mountain; organ/guitar harmonies noted as beautiful.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill and Mickey produce a tribal‑sounding five‑minute drum segment, followed by a brief, experimental space section.
